entities.summary: The Saint Petersburg State University of Engineering and Economics was a public university in Russia, which was known as ENGECON. It is now a part of Saint Petersburg State University of Economics, which was created via its merging with Saint Petersburg State University of Economics and Finance and Saint Petersburg State University of Service and Economics. It was specialized in the fields of economics, management, statistics, logistics and finance.
